title: Robust Budget Pacing with a Single Sample
abstract: arXiv:2302.02006v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Major Internet advertising platforms offer budget pacing tools as a standard service for advertisers to manage their ad campaigns. Given the inherent non-stationarity in an advertiser's value and also competing advertisers' values over time, a commonly used approach is to learn a target expenditure plan that specifies a target spend as a function of time, and then run a controller that tracks this plan. This raises the question: how many historical samples are required to learn a good expenditure plan? We study this question by considering an advertiser repeatedly participating in $T$ second-price auctions, where the tuple of her value and the highest competing bid is drawn from an unknown time-varying distribution. The advertiser seeks to maximize her total utility subject to her budget constraint. translated_title: 基于单样本的鲁棒预算节奏控制
translated_abstract: 主流互联网广告平台将预算节奏控制工具作为广告主管理广告活动的标准服务。鉴于广告主自身价值以及竞争对手价值随时间存在的固有非平稳性，一种常用的方法是先学习一个目标支出计划（该计划将目标花费指定为时间的函数），然后运行一个控制器来跟踪该计划。由此引出一个问题：需要多少历史样本才能学到一个好的支出计划？我们通过考虑一个广告主重复参与 T 轮二价拍卖来研究这一问题，其中她的价值与最高竞争出价组成的元组来自一个未知的时变分布。广告主的目标是在预算约束下最大化其总效用。已有研究表明，每个分布需要 T log T 个样本才能实现最优的 O(√T) 遗憾界。我们极大地……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明在广告拍卖的预算节奏控制中，仅需单个历史样本即可学到鲁棒的支出计划并达到最优的 O(√T) 遗憾界，大幅改进了以往需要 T log T 个样本的结果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a single historical sample suffices to learn a robust expenditure plan for budget pacing in repeated second-price auctions, achieving the optimal O(√T)-regret and dramatically improving upon prior work that required T log T samples.
